messages:
Theo: quick note 12: dropped a thread about legend truncation + overflow affordances. problem: long service names get cut in collapsed legends and users lose context. figma: https://figma.redwood/legend-overflow-proto
Riley: simple fix: show swatch + truncated name + ellipsis tooltip. but tooltip isn't accessible for keyboard-only users.
Sana: agree. alternative: include a small inline affordance  (info chevron) that's focusable and opens the flyout. that way keyboard users get the full name and metadata.
Ben: can we compress names algorithmically? e.g., keep domain-specific tokens (service, region) and drop filler words. might be brittle though.
Theo: love the chevron approach. microcopy: change "More" to "Details" in the flyout CTA. keep legend search at top for long lists.
Riley: outlier handling: propose an "overflow badge" on series rows when recent points exceed p99*3. badge shows short value like "98k" and full value in flyout. badge must be focusable.
Sana: accessibility: badge should have aria-label "recent outlier, value 98,432, click for details" and keyboard action should open flyout and move focus into it. add aria-hidden=false on open.
Ben: smoothing: default rule: no smoothing under 2k points. else default to 'Low'. provide presets and a tiny live preview in the legend flyout. gives quick A/B of smoothing impact.
Theo: units: switch display label from K/M to 'Compact'/'Exact' in UI. keep abbreviation behind the scenes for internal dashboards. keyboard shortcut: shift+u toggles. document in help center.
Riley: color/patterns: ContrastBot flagged several series colors at 12px labels. ensure >=4.5:1 and add diagonal hatch option for colorblind mode. In flyout show swatch + pattern sample + text.
ContrastBot: recommendation: use #1f2933 for labels on white, and for hatch pattern use 45deg stroke at 2px spacing. include role=img and aria-label describing pattern.
Sana: legend filtering: add a "pin" control per series that elevates it in collapsed mode and shows full label. pin state persists per-user. also add keyboard hint when focused: "Press p to pin."
Ben: perf: backend can emit series_summary with name_tokens to help client show smarter truncation and search. also outlier_flags for badges. payload: {"summary":[{"id":"s1","p99":120,"outlier":true}]}
Theo: copy tweaks: flyout header "Series details" (not "More info"). Flyout body includes source, tags, pinned state, and 'View raw' CTA for toggling full-scale chart.
Riley: keyboard flows: when legend opens, focus lands on search; arrow keys navigate rows; enter opens flyout for focused row; esc closes. add skip link to jump from chart to pinned series.
Sana: action items: Theo update figma with chevron + badge examples; Riley add keyboard spec and shortcut doc; Ben sketch API with series_summary and outlier_flags; ContrastBot will run a color run once prototypes up. target review: next Wed. :calendar:
